text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm Super Creek~ Fufu, it's nice to meet 
you~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My dream... hmm. What is your dream, 
Trainer? I'd love to make that come true 
for you♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Please don't hold back, just tell me. If 
you let me spoil you lots and lots, that 
alone will make me so happy~.

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
